tweets.text: Will Iran surrender? Will a deal emerge? Will Trump relent? Will some new leader in Tehran finally make peace with Washington? All of these questions miss the point, because all of them assume the regime has something it can actually trade. The proxies, the nuclear program, the missiles, the drones: none of that is policy the regime adopted and could just as easily drop. All of it is what the Islamic Republic is. The militias in Lebanon, Iraq, Yemen and Gaza, the enrichment, the missile force, together they make up the regime’s claim to lead the resistance and to outlast the order it was built to overturn. Take them away and you no longer have the Islamic Republic.
